# Aerodrome

> Aerodrome (Aerodrome Group) develops and produces long-range precision strike systems. Its product, Phoenix LT, is an unmanned one-way attack aircraft with strategic range, in the category also described as loitering munitions, one-way attack drones or kamikaze drones. Aerodrome also offers the APEX LT ground platform for fleet and mission management, and aerial data services. Tagline: Long-range capability. Within reach.

Key facts:
- Phoenix LT: strategic range, warhead of up to 50 kg, rocket-booster launch with no runway, image-based navigation that holds course when GPS is jammed, anti-jam GPS, inertial navigation and homing, redundant systems, open mission architecture.
- Positioning: strategic range and payload at a fraction of a cruise missile's cost; designed for serial production and resupply; a human authorises every engagement.
- Delivery: supply from Aerodrome's production line, local production with the customer's industry, and training, spares and upgrades for 10+ years.
- Supply is subject to export licensing. Full specifications are shared under NDA.

## Products and solutions
- [Phoenix LT](https://aerodrome-group.com/phoenix-lt/): long-range precision strike system; capabilities, key facts and delivery models.
- [APEX LT](https://aerodrome-group.com/apex-lt/): ground platform for Phoenix fleets: fleet overview, mission planning, individual UAV control, technician diagnostics.
- [Aerial Services](https://aerodrome-group.com/aerial-services/): aerial photography, mapping and 3D modelling, flight and integration services.
